items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: we come back here and record Thursday and Friday with Jerry Jerome

ctx.x: What’s going to be on your calendar for the upcoming — the same?

Bobby Short starts, we are in mid-March now as we speak and Bobby starts, well I’m going this coming Tuesday, today being Saturday, I’m going down to Vero Beach with Ruby Braff and Bill Charlap and a couple of other fellas, I don’t even who the con— we’re going to go down there and do a concert. And then we come back here and record Thursday and Friday with Jerry Jerome who is 89. Dick Hyman is writing the music for it. Tommy Newsom is on it and some of the folks in this festival here. And then next month I’m…
told him, I’ve got this booked, I can’t get out of it. And so I’m actually sending a sub into the Carlyle for three nights. I’m going to hear about that.
